name: Amsterdam Airport Schiphol

runway.v: longest runway 18R/36L, 3,800 m long and 60 m wide (six runways in all)

curfew.v: general aviation, including business aviation, is in principle not allowed at night, 2200-0600 UTC in winter (2100-0500 UTC in summer), i.e. 23:00-07:00 local; the slot coordinator sets night capacity for general aviation at 0
curfew.quote: General aviation is in principle not allowed to operate during the night between 2200-0600 (2100-0500).

slots.v: a slot from the coordinator ACNL is required for every general aviation landing and take-off; ad hoc slots are requested after the slot return date in GCR format, usually via the operator or handler
slots.quote: Slot requests for GA must be filed in the general aviation clearance request (GCR) format according the SSIM Appendix K.

max_aircraft.v: in winter 2026-27, no general aviation stand capacity for larger aircraft (ICAO code D, E, F) for arrivals 0620-0934 UTC and departures 0620-1159 UTC; exceptions at the airport's discretion
max_aircraft.quote: Arrival slots from 0620 up to and including 0934 ... Departure slots from 0620 up to and including 1159 ... Applicable to flights with ICAO code: | D | E | F |

notes: Night window: AIP gives 2200-0600 (2100-0500); the ACNL W26 capacity declaration states times in UTC with local in brackets and defines a night movement as 2200-0559 UTC (2300-0659 LT), so 23:00-07:00 local applies in both seasons (bracketed AIP times are the summer UTC times). GEN 2.1 time-system page could not be opened to quote the convention directly. The max_aircraft quote joins three table cells from the ACNL declaration. AIP edition used: AIRAC AMDT 06-2026 (effective 11 Jun 2026), the newest edition found online; a later edition may be in force. Handling agents are listed in AD 2.23, which was not reached.
